text.description_html:
Deltana SSPBB2410, 24 Inch Contemporary Stainless Steel Back-to-Back Door Pull Set

The Back-to-Back 24 Inch Contemporary Pulls have an overall length of 25 inches and a 1 inch grip. This pair of stainless steel handles comes packaged as a complete set, including 2 pulls and the mounting hardware to install them on wood, fiberglass, metal, or glass doors. The Contemporary Stainless Steel Back-to-Back Door Pull Set is available in 3 finishes: polished stainless steel, brushed stainless steel, or matte black. No matter which finish you choose, the base will be constructed of high-quality stainless for a lasting and modern look.

Packaged with Back to Back mounting (2 door pulls bolted to each other - 1 door pull for each side of a door). Includes rosettes to securely tighten the door pulls to the door.

Also available as an individual Deltana SSP2410 Contemporary 24" Pull.

Specifications of the Deltana Square Stainless Steel Handle Back to Back Pair:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Total Length: 25"
  • Center to Center: 24"
  • Pull Handle Length: 1" square
  • Projection: 2-5/8"
  • Clearance: 1-5/8"
  • Door Thickness: for doors up to 1-7/8" thick
  • Screws: 8 mm x 1.25 mm
  • Includes installation hardware required for glass, fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.
  • Deltana SSPBB2410 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

*Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back to Back mounting.
